result.keyword: What's the best e-signature software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, I would shortlist **Dropbox Sign, DocuSign and PandaDoc**\. However, the best choice depends on whether you simply need customers to sign contracts or want a complete document-management and sales workflow.

My recommendation: **Dropbox Sign for simplicity and value, or DocuSign for a more established business-grade solution.**

## Best e-signature software compared

![PandaDoc Review: Sign, Seal, Deliver](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/0MUKV24vOJ8Fy84anuzrEeDfSf0kpDjVQFizvzFH_No27CWsxijbo2OMMlOGpvgS85vZB3wg04yrL3uUEA8HfUdyjeWSSz3aH8VUzmHL1gINYfR2lzt9WJR1seELOV2zEpePqA9WPggyXDEs9xtNtG6ptm3fJ7rmZx4q6N4W7fYpmzjZfQx9dTipSbsTdrj3?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign**

(Best for most small businesses)

- Simple to use and quick to set up.
- Easy document sending and signing.
- Templates, reminders and audit trails.
- Good for client agreements and service contracts.

Indicative starting price: US\$15/month.

[Dropbox Sign website](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![ドキュサイン / Docusign について](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/xyLq-c8NsrpmXngTDQOlq_nQ-hdoipi8LNAM0PriPm9OXbxzSMFpxHq4mX20RE5oKykXn_ebymihRHVC-xJF-ftlT3muOwPqVZr1LnypOPP6tZDIkDq6IjuWnsebSgjW-6slAQlpUZa-Wz9woFg0UDt6Xeug0D4ulHXJQLs86h2xGptBRDNSUfxqteGaxXDR?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. DocuSign**

(Best overall business platform)

- Widely recognised by customers and businesses.
- Strong audit trails and authentication options.
- Excellent integrations and signing workflows.
- Good for businesses expecting to grow.

Indicative starting price: US\$11/month.

[DocuSign website](https://www.docusign.com/)

---

![PandaDoc buys Denario for consolidated document and payment workflow offering](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/nMZU-ikvjF7B27p2YRYbwMFVYldny8ofYsWDYYkqTXdGfrk-N9sresjiQS7_N5GL_z3bC2xtBlASA1wbjcPGc7QwN2zoEnDhBBAByuwL6PooRYdhb5Xb7bjGtsls49X_kKuOQ8O8ieH---UeiE5fGOQC1qFIRtUd6uc0-JR89a70cw5k0Vpz1IUhRMFOX01b?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PandaDoc**

(Best for proposals and sales)

- Create professional quotes and proposals.
- Reusable document templates.
- Electronic signatures and document tracking.
- Useful for sales teams and client onboarding.

Indicative starting price: US\$19/user/month annually.

[PandaDoc website](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

---

![Adobe Acrobat Sign Solutions for business Transaction New](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/boFV63978924LtJqDW6sL1JIitAIaS-BthRNk192q0PHK-HvHdZBMxqDjDCO72LE2oPF1ayxecsE94Q-YPvxHO-S7Mi38P9TmXNhPAUlm7-8leU4NJBCSUCriipzFK7eQRBF1P54X7oN4viJGvAqlvPFeHJwJMDSU5H8EIj-uBFDS8q0gO8ZF29lIfJEU-lB?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Adobe Acrobat Sign**

- Excellent PDF editing and signing.
- Useful if you already use Adobe Acrobat.
- Good document management and integrations.

Indicative starting price: US\$16.99/month for a team licence.

[Adobe Acrobat Sign website](https://www.adobe.com/acrobat/business/e-signature.html)

---

![Zoho Sign - Apps Documentation](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/SUcET-87d95vVganDQlyhWq-yiws-wQ_od0uceT-oSgYYMR06035CJR-_lwRhqFA2Wk42Qb4rsaFUnfX59ev935AI6sAEgF3T2dA_v2J3qmxQzTtV0tKWD6AvgqazINgryECCXcm3UqYqzrO6XPMiLUxQFIqLMyy4JMl92yn0HiutGHZpNfO5gb5ETOux07n?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Zoho Sign**

- Affordable option for smaller businesses.
- Integrates with Zoho CRM and other Zoho apps.
- Templates, reminders and audit trails.

Indicative starting price: US\$10/user/month annually.

[Zoho Sign website](https://www.zoho.com/sign/)

*Prices are indicative USD starting prices, not confirmed Australian quotes. Plans and sending limits vary.* [helpcompare.com](https://helpcompare.com/e-signature/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[serpastra.com](https://serpastra.com/blog/best-e-signature-software-for-small-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[dupple.com](https://dupple.com/learn/best-e-signature-software?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I'd look for in Australia

Since you're operating in Australia, I'd prioritise\:

- Legally valid electronic signatures and reliable signer identification.
- A downloadable signed PDF.
- A tamper-evident audit certificate showing who signed and when.
- Automated reminders for customers who haven't signed.
- Reusable templates for contracts and agreements.
- Straightforward pricing in AUD, if available.

Electronic signatures are generally recognised under Australian electronic transactions legislation, provided requirements around identification, intention, reliability and consent are met. Some documents have exceptions or additional requirements. [www.ag.gov.au](https://www.ag.gov.au/legal-system/electronic-signatures-documents-and-transactions/electronic-signatures?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.ag.gov.au](https://www.ag.gov.au/legal-system/electronic-signatures-documents-and-transactions?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[legislation.nsw.gov.au](https://legislation.nsw.gov.au/view/whole/pdf/inforce/2024-10-10/act-2000-008?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

| Your business needs | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| Simple customer contracts | Dropbox Sign |
| Professional business agreements | DocuSign |
| Quotes, proposals and sales | PandaDoc |
| PDF editing and signing | Adobe Acrobat Sign |
| Low-cost signing | Zoho Sign |

search_results.title: The best e-signature software in 2026
search_results.description: This 2026 guide evaluates leading e-signature platforms for functionality, security, integrations, usability, device compatibility, and legal compliance. Adobe Acrobat Sign is named the best overall option, offering extensive customization, authentication, SAP SuccessFactors integration, mobile and web access, and plans starting at $16.99 monthly with a seven-day trial. DocuSign is recommended for business value, particularly high-volume signing, with templates, tracking, reporting, strong security, broad integrations, and plans from $10 monthly. Dropbox Sign is the budget choice, emphasizing ease of use, cloud-storage compatibility, branding, templates, and AES-256/TLS encryption from $9.99 monthly. eSignatures.io suits freelancers needing pay-as-you-go bulk contracts, charging per contract with discounted credits. SignNow is best for multiple signers, offering collaboration, reusable templates, drag-and-drop fields, and real-time tracking. PandaDoc is recommended for creating sophisticated documents, combining e-signatures with publishing tools, templates, content libraries, CRM integrations, and payment tracking. The guide advises selecting software based on workflow, compliance, security, features, integrations, and budget.
